title: USC Registration Calendar (Office of Academic Records and Registrar)
text:
Note: this page lists Spring 2027 first; it also lists Summer 2026 and Fall 2026 dates. Dates are for session 001 unless noted.

SPRING 2027
- Oct 5, 2026: Registration appointment times and permit-to-register information are available at my.usc.edu. Students register through Web Registration (webreg.usc.edu/Login).
- Oct 26, 2026: Registration for continuing students begins.
- Jan 4-8, 2027: Registration for spring semester continues.
- Jan 8, 2027: Last day to register and settle without a late fee (session 001).
- Jan 11, 2027: Spring semester classes begin.
- Jan 18, 2027: Martin Luther King Day, university holiday.
- Jan 29, 2027 (session 001): Last day to register for classes, drop a class for a refund, enroll for Pass/No Pass or Audit, and purchase or waive tuition refund insurance.
- Feb 2, 2027 (session 001): Last day to add/drop a Monday-only class without a "W" and receive a refund, or change it to Pass/No Pass or Audit.
- Feb 15, 2027: President's Day, university holiday.
- Feb 26, 2027 (session 001): Last day to drop a course without a "W" on the transcript, and last day to change Pass/No Pass to a letter grade.
- Mar 14-21, 2027: Spring recess.
- Apr 9, 2027 (session 001): Last day to withdraw from a course (W deadline).
- Apr 30, 2027: Spring semester classes end.
- May 1-4, 2027: Study days.
- May 5-12, 2027: Final examinations. The final exam schedule is at arr.usc.edu/final-exam-schedule.
- May 5-18, 2027: Final grade submission via the Grading and Roster System (GRS).
- Limited status students: may request spring 2027 enrollment starting Nov 19, 2026. The deadline is Dec 14, 2026, with no exceptions, and late course-add petitions are not allowed.

SUMMER 2026
- Feb 9: Schedule of classes available. Feb 23: Registration begins.
- May 20: First six-week session begins. May 25: Memorial Day, holiday.
- June 19: Juneteenth, non-instructional day. June 24: Last day to purchase or waive Tuition Refund Insurance.
- June 30: Last day of first session. July 1: Second six-week session begins.
- July 3-4: Independence Day observed, holiday.
- Aug 11: Last day of summer classes.

FALL 2026
- Mar 2: Registration appointment times available on Experience USC (experience.usc.edu) and Web Registration.
- Aug 17-21: Registration continues. Aug 21: Last day to register without a late fee (session 001).
- Aug 24: Fall semester classes begin.
- Sep 7: Labor Day, holiday.
- Sep 11 (session 001): Last day to register, receive a refund, enroll for Pass/No Pass or Audit, or purchase/waive Tuition Refund Insurance.
- Sep 15 (session 001): Last day to add/drop a Monday-only class without a "W" and receive a refund.
- Oct 8-9: Fall recess. Oct 9 (session 001): Last day to change Pass/No Pass to a letter grade, and last day to drop without a "W."
- Nov 11: Veterans Day, non-instructional day.
- Nov 13 (session 001): Last day to withdraw from a course.
- Nov 25-29: Thanksgiving holiday.
- Dec 4: Fall semester classes end. Dec 5-8: Study days. Dec 9-16: Final exams.
- Dec 9-22: Final grade submission via GRS.
- Limited status students: may request fall enrollment starting Apr 17 by emailing the Registrar's Office (ask.usc.edu/s/emailus).

CONTACT
- Phone: 213-740-2311
- Ask USC: ask.usc.edu/s/
- Contact page: arr.usc.edu/contact-us/
